purpose: Freeze the narrow reversible materialization seam between the qualified F-SI28 soil-water solve and the existing legacy SoilWater(3) acceptance/postsolve path. This is not a second transaction and does not broaden F-SI28 scientific admission.

soilwater.finding_task2: SoilWater(2) first calls SoilWaterStateVar(1), then delegates the hydraulic solve to HeadCalc; no accepted postsolve bookkeeping occurs in task 2.
soilwater.finding_task3: SoilWater(3) recomputes k/kmean from accepted h/theta, recomputes gwl via calcgwl(), then calls watstor() and fluxes().

controller_retry.finding: SoilWater(2) executes inside the fldtreduce retry loop. If fldecdt becomes true, SoilWaterStateVar(2) restores the hydraulic state and TimeControl(5) drives retry; task 3 is not executed for that rejected trial.

controller_accept.finding: After successful exit from the retry loop, SoilWater(3) is called exactly once before integral(3) and downstream accepted-step processes.

solver_binding.finding: F-SI28 returns candidate pressure_head/water_content/ponding_depth/groundwater_level plus top_flux/bottom_flux, diagnostics and optional result-only interface sensitivity. Solver scratch remains workspace-owned.

independent_legacy_crosscheck.finding: watstor() consumes theta for profile storage. fluxes() recomputes q(:) from accepted theta/thetm1, qtop, qbot and already-owned sink/drainage/storage terms; it does not require HeadCalc Jacobian/factorization/Newton scratch or a q(:) postimage from the solver service.

conservative_but_recomputed_by_task3: gwl <- result.candidate_state.groundwater_level; SoilWater(3) subsequently recomputes gwl from accepted h via calcgwl(), so gwl is not a hidden task2 dependency

explicitly_forbidden_capsule_content: a second copy of outer transaction continuation state

retry_and_accept_rules.converged: Materialize only the accepted fields above, expose F-SI28 result metadata to the F-KT14 bridge, then allow the unchanged SoilWater(3) postsolve path exactly once.
retry_and_accept_rules.retry_advised: Do not publish sensitivity or accepted result metadata; map to the existing legacy fldecdt/retry path so SoilWaterStateVar(2) restores the current-step state and SoilWater(3) is skipped.
retry_and_accept_rules.failed: Fail closed without accepted postimage publication or SoilWater(3) execution.
retry_and_accept_rules.unsupported_route: Use the unchanged direct legacy HeadCalc path; do not execute both the typed solver and HeadCalc for one hydraulic trial.
